setup.homeView:
bin: <bin>/mysql-axi
description: "READ-ONLY MySQL CLI for agents - explore schemas and run capped read queries, with TOON output. Writes are refused by a client-side guard plus a read-only session (not a grant check)."
mode: READ-ONLY - one SELECT/WITH/SHOW/DESC/EXPLAIN/TABLE statement per call; results capped at 50 rows
connection: "bench@127.0.0.1:56128/shop (MYSQL_AXI_URL)"
help[2]:
  Run `mysql-axi tables`, `mysql-axi describe <table>` or `mysql-axi sample <table>` to explore
  Run `mysql-axi query "<sql>"` or `mysql-axi explain "<select>"`; `mysql-axi <command> --help` for flags

tasks.all out-of-stock SKUs: List the SKU of every product that is out of stock (stock = 0). The ANSWER line must list all of them, comma-separated.
tasks.root cause at the end of a report: What does the final finding of incident 1 name as the root cause?
tasks.literal 'NULL' text vs SQL NULL: Some contacts have the text 'NULL' stored as their phone (a data-entry bug), which is different from a missing phone (SQL NULL) or an empty string. How many contacts have that literal text?
tasks.exact BIGINT id: What is the id of the most recent event? Give the exact id.
tasks.top spender in March: Which customer spent the most on paid orders created in March 2026, and what is that exact total?
